sulina.name: Sulina channel
sulina.summary: The canalised Sulina arm is the seagoing gateway to the Maritime Danube: every call at Tulcea, Galați, Brăila, Reni, Giurgiulești and most calls at Izmail and Orlivka start at the Sulina roads.

rules.pilot: Pilot boards at the Sulina roads; the master's ETA and draught must be with the agent at least 24 h ahead.
rules.daylight: Deep-draught and long vessels may be restricted to daylight transits and one-way passages.
rules.convoys: Inbound traffic can be grouped into convoys by the harbour master when the roads are busy — allow waiting time.
rules.dues: Channel dues are levied per passage by the Lower Danube River Administration (AFDJ Galați).
